decisions.statement: A change the command line reaches reads the arguments handed in rather than trusting the arguments.
An argument such a change was handed no value for is refused by the key naming that argument.
A change's slug names the mode then the thing acted on then the part of that thing.
The kind of file a path names is read from `target-kinding` rather than worked out in each change.
The path a change acts on is named `at`.
The paths a change moves a thing between are named `from` and `to`.
A change naming a page rather than a path names it for what the page is here.
A change acts only on a target whose kind narrows the subtype that change states.
That subtype is judged before the change runs rather than inside the change.
Every target type, subtype and mode that together make sense has a change.
Where the pages of a page type sit is no concern of that page type, so no change carries them.
One root manifest is the only manifest, so no change adds a manifest or a way into one.

definition: one change to the repository, reached by name

directives.name: Correctness In The Writer
directives.act: Build into a mechanical writer every truth a check would have caught.
directives.warrant: A mechanical change runs no check, so a wrong value it writes lands silently and stays.
aids: Reaching the change system is not being judged.
A check that exists refuses nothing a mechanical change writes.
